long_biography.plain_text:
Rolnick's businesses have joined product ideas to international supply chains and large retail customers. As president of Kontakt US International, he brought Italian cashmere and merino clothing to Costco stores. He later participated in a venture that designed, manufactured and sold outdoor furniture to the same retailer, extending his work from apparel into household goods.

He has since directed a family group of companies with an emphasis on durable products for the home. Its chief executive and managing director, Rolnick sets expansion strategy and makes major investment decisions across the businesses he owns. He has also overseen asset acquisitions and divestitures beyond consumer products, including interests in aerospace, marine and property.
